messages:
Amanda (ACME): Hey — urgent. We expect default retention of 30d for our org but objects created 35+ days ago are still coming back in search. These are potential PII results. Sample IDs: O-12345, O-98765. Can someone help?
Sarah (Support): Sorry to hear that. Can you share org/account id and a sample object payload/metadata and any audit/event ids you have? Also confirm whether a legal hold was placed.
Amanda (ACME): Org: acme-prod-42. No explicit legal hold on these objects that we know of. We migrated a few projects under the org default policy last week (Mar 1). Upload+search steps below.
Amanda (ACME): Steps to repro: 1) POST /v1/objects -> returns 201 with id O-12345 (created_at: 3367385123) 2) Wait 35 days 3) GET /v1/search?q=email:joe@acme.com -> returns O-12345 in results. No delete event in our UI.
Amanda (ACME): Example response snippet:
```json
{
  "id": "O-12345",
  "created_at": 3367385123,
  "ttl": 2592000,
  "tombstone": true,
  "visible": true
}
```
Sarah (Support): Thanks — tagging eng/sre. @Ops (Oncall) @Leo (Eng) — please triage. We'll also need the audit_event_id if available.
sre-bot: Incident created INC-7891 and assigned to Ops (Oncall).
Javier (CS): Adding context: the migration applied an "inherit org default" policy to a subset of projects on 3367300000. Could be an inheritance edge-case.
Leo (Eng): Quick checks: 1) Do audit logs show the TTL-delete / tombstone application event? 2) Did we rotate KMS keys around the delete time? 3) Is tombstone true in storage but tombstone not applied to search index?
Amanda (ACME): Audit event id for batch delete attempt: evt_202v7. We have a log entry from the delete worker that shows success: 
```
POST /internal/delete-batch 200 
processed: [O-12345, O-98765] 
job_id: jb-4452
```
But search still returns items.
Leo (Eng): That's confusing but useful. Can you paste the object metadata HEAD response? specifically fields: tombstone, delete_ts, storage_key, kms_key_id.
Amanda (ACME): HEAD /v1/objects/O-12345 ->
```json
{ "id": "O-12345", "tombstone": true, "delete_ts": 3367535123, "storage_key": "s3://objs/acme/..", "kms_key_id": "rk-79" }
```
Sarah (Support): So storage shows tombstone:true and delete_ts present, but search returns visible:true — looks like indexer didn't remove the doc. @Ops (Oncall) can you check indexer logs for tenant acme-prod-42 around delete_ts?
Ops (Oncall): I pulled indexer logs — around 3367535123 we have errors: `indexer: apply_tombstone acme-prod-42 O-12345 -> 500 timeout` and retries subsequently succeeded for some tenants but these IDs show a retry failure cluster. Looks like the tombstone failed to propagate to the search cluster.
Leo (Eng): That explains search visibility. Root causes to investigate: a) transient indexing failures (timeouts) during batch delete window b) index rehydration / reingest that reintroduced documents c) possible race when a reindex job ran concurrently with tombstone apply. Also checking whether KMS rotation caused the indexer to be unable to fetch metadata (it shouldn't block tombstone, but if metadata was unreadable a worker could skip).
Priya (Legal): Place an immediate preservation hold on acme-prod-42 and affected object ids. Do not purge anything until legal confirms. We need the audit log bundle for discovery.
Javier (CS): Confirming we will snapshot the tenant and add to preserve. @Amanda please confirm hold acknowledged.
Amanda (ACME): Confirmed — hold accepted. Please preserve and notify when safe to resume purges.
Leo (Eng): Next engineering actions: 1) Run focused reindex for objects [O-12345,O-98765] with tombstone enforcement (no rehydrate); 2) Pull and attach indexer error traces to INC-7891; 3) Verify KMS key rk-79 access around delete_ts (no DENY events). We'll post updates in the incident.
Sarah (Support): I'll assemble the audit bundle and share to legal (Priya) and the customer. ETA for initial reindex attempt: 45m.
Ops (Oncall): Reindex job queued: reindex-job-884. If anyone needs immediate results, PM me.
Priya (Legal): Received audit bundle when ready. Also request a signed attestation once objects are confirmed tombstoned in search and snapshot is taken.
Amanda (ACME): Thanks — appreciate the fast turn. Please confirm when objects are removed from search.
Sarah (Support): Will update the thread. Marking escalated to ENG/SRE and Legal. :white_check_mark:
notes: escalated: data retention / tombstone not propagated to search index; legal hold placed
